top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A merry go cycle was observed without loose fill beneath.    Note: A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: While reviewing directors qualifications on the boad it was seen the Children's Product Certification had not been signed since January 2, 2022. This was corrected at the inspection when a new certification form was signed.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §746.201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies were not complete.

top_violation_types.title: Requirements for Tire - Not Suspended from a Composite Structure (26 TAC §746.4705(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a tire swing attached to a composite structure.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plans (26 TAC §746.2203(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Activity plan was not available for review.
